vocabulary.note: DF = dogfooding-log friction ids; WI are the same items as PRJ-207 work items in FitAdapt's Meridian book; the rest are FitAdapt book ids — context only.

channel.rule: One issue per request. A request is answered on its issue, and the answer is what moves `accepted`.

acceptance.done: merged to Meridian's default branch (main) with its test; docs/36 §0: a line built only on a branch is `partial`, and says so in `remaining`
acceptance.accepted: the requester re-tested it and said so on the issue. Only the requester writes this.
acceptance.notAccepted: the requester is in a position to answer and has not.
acceptance.cannotAnswerYet: accepted is null: nothing is delivered to try, or the requester cannot judge it until a tag carries it.
acceptance.released: a version tag a third party can fetch carries it (v5.9.1 is not on the remote as of 2026-09-23, so nothing here is released)

channel.escalation: a rejected done or refusal goes back to open with the objection quoted; a disagreement is written in both registers rather than settled in one

history.note: issue #16 open on 2026-09-23
Delivered by docs/36 wave 2 (5.26.0).

requests.answerToSource: Closed in 5.26.0 (D-36.12). An administrator gives the council member a review grant on the programme or on one project (Administration → the account's grants → “Add a review grant”). It carries approving evidence and reading that scope, and nothing else, so the member stays a viewer everywhere else and signs in their own name; the product owner no longer approves on their behalf. A document can name the seat expected to approve it, and the gate reads “waiting on seat A1”. What to try: grant review on FitAdapt's programme to a council account, file a document with its seat, and approve it as the member.

history.note: issue #17 open on 2026-09-23
Delivered by docs/36 wave 2 (5.25.0).

requests.answerToSource: Closed in 5.25.0 (D-36.14). A project, stage, RAID row or gate criterion can now point at `owner/repo#17`, a commit, a CI run or an artefact digest. Meridian never fetches GitHub: your Action pushes the state to PUT /api/v1/references/<id> (without `project`, it only reports a state for kind + ref, and every link citing that PR follows). What to try: link a module's stage to its PR on the project page, then push `merged` from the Action and reload.
